intro.title: Space Station Alpha
intro.text: Year 2525. You're a cadet on Space Station Alpha when alarms blare: 'System failure! The AI needs recoding!' The captain: 'Learn to code or we're adrift forever!'

cargo.title: Cargo Bay Variables
cargo.text: In the cargo bay, boxes float everywhere. The robot CHIP-8: 'Use VARIABLES to label cargo! Each box needs an identifier to track contents.'

cargo_success.title: Cargo Organized!
cargo_success.text: CHIP-8 celebrates: 'Perfect! Variables let the system track 10,000 items effortlessly!' The bay's lights turn green.

cargo_lesson.title: System Overload
cargo_lesson.text: CHIP-8 sparks: 'Too much data! Without variables, the computer can't track anything. Let me show you...'

lifesupport.title: Life Support Conditionals
lifesupport.text: Oxygen system flashes red. CHIP-8: 'Use IF-ELSE! IF oxygen less than 20%, activate emergency, ELSE maintain normal.' Current: 15%.

lifesupport_success.title: Breathing Easy!
lifesupport_success.text: Oxygen floods the station! CHIP-8: 'You checked the condition (15% < 20%) and took correct action. Conditionals save lives!'

lifesupport_lesson.title: Critical Error!
lifesupport_lesson.text: Alarms intensify! CHIP-8: 'Wrong! 15% IS less than 20%, so IF is TRUE. We need emergency tanks!'

engine.title: Engine Loop
engine.text: Engine needs 100 micro-adjustments per second. CHIP-8: 'No time for 100 commands! Use a LOOP to repeat automatically!'

engine_success.title: Engines Online!
engine_success.text: Engines roar to life! CHIP-8: 'One loop handled 100 adjustments instantly. That's the power of loops!'

engine_lesson.title: Too Slow!
engine_lesson.text: You're only at #5 when CHIP-8 stops you: 'At this rate, 10 minutes! Loops do it in milliseconds!'

bridge.title: Bridge Functions
bridge.text: Captain: 'We call navigate(), scan(), and communicate() constantly. Create FUNCTIONS so we can reuse them!'

bridge_success.title: Mission Control!
bridge_success.text: Station hums perfectly! Captain: 'With functions, complex operations become simple. You saved us all!'

bridge_lesson.title: Code Chaos
bridge_lesson.text: Screen fills with duplicate code. CHIP-8: 'Functions prevent repetition! Write once, use everywhere!'

finale.title: Hero of the Station
finale.text: Captain salutes: 'You mastered fundamentals and saved 10,000 lives! Variables organize, conditionals decide, loops repeat, functions simplify!'

complete.title: Mission Complete!
complete.text: Congratulations! You've saved Space Station Alpha and mastered coding fundamentals!
